user.title: Sign in to Mer
user.description: Use the e-mail and password of your Mer Connect / Driver Portal account. Once signed in, add the chargers you want to monitor with the Add charger button on the integration's page.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate Mer
reauth_confirm.description: The password for {username} no longer works. Enter the new password.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Mer driver portal

abort.already_configured: This Mer account is already configured

init.title: Poll interval
init.description: Chargers are added and removed on the integration's page, not here.

user.title: Search for a charging site
user.description: Type any part of the site's name as it appears in the Mer app. The search is not case-sensitive and matches anywhere in the name, so a single distinctive word such as the town, the street or the business is enough. You will pick the site from the matches on the next page.

data_description.search: For example, part of a town name or a car park's name.

site_select.title: Choose the site
site_select.description: Sites matching "{search}". Not the right one? Pick "Search again" at the bottom.

stations.title: Choose the chargers to add
stations.description: Chargers at {site} that you have not added yet. Each one becomes its own device, grouped under the site.

data.back: Not here? Go back and choose a different site

reconfigure.title: Change chargers at {site}
reconfigure.description: Tick the chargers to monitor at this site. Unticking one removes its device and entities. To stop monitoring the whole site, delete it from its menu instead.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Mer driver portal

abort.already_configured: That site is already added; use Add charger again to add more of its chargers.
abort.all_stations_configured: Every charger at that site is already added
abort.invalid_auth: Stored password no longer works; re-authenticate the integration first
abort.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Mer driver portal
abort.no_stations: No chargers were found at that site

no_active_session.message: There is no active charging session to stop

session_not_here.message: This charger is not running your charging session

command_unconfirmed.message: Mer accepted the command, but the charger did not confirm it within {seconds} seconds. Check the charger; the entities will update on the next refresh.
